headings.text: Improve Your English Pronunciation at Home (No Teacher Needed)

paragraphs: You do not need a coach. Use minimal pairs, shadowing and tongue twisters at home to sound clearer in 15 minutes a day.
Clear pronunciation matters more than a big vocabulary. People understand you when sounds are right. Here is a home routine.
Minimal pairs are words that differ by one sound: "ship" vs "sheep", "bat" vs "bet". Say each pair slowly. Record. The SpeakNow minimal-pairs tool scores your accuracy.
Play a short English clip. Repeat immediately, copying rhythm and stress. Do not translate. Just echo. Five minutes daily trains your mouth muscles.
"She sells sea shells." "Red lorry yellow lorry." Start slow, then speed up. They fix tricky sounds like s, r, l, th.
Indians often say "dis" for "this". Put tongue between teeth: "this, that, three, think". Practice 10 times.
Use your phone. Say a sentence. Play it. Compare with a native audio. Note the gap.
In 30 days your speech will be noticeably clearer. The SpeakNow pronunciation tool gives instant feedback so you never practise wrong.
Free browser-based English speaking practice. No downloads, no sign-ups, no data leaving your computer.
